title: VipPolicyEvaluateRequest
description: vip.policy-evaluate-request@1: the question of vip.resource.policy.evaluate on OpenVibe.VIP. POST /api/v1/policies/evaluate: { resource, owner, subject?, rule_id?, mode?, fallback? }: may subject see resource, owned (says the product) by creator owner? Only the owner's rule applies; rule_id pins the rule the product expects. fallback is the product's own default gate, used only when the owner has no active rule. A person asks about themselves (403 vip.not_yours otherwise); a service may leave subject out (a signed-out viewer: the answer is no). Nothing is refused for a bad resource, owner or fallback: the answer is allow false with the reason (invalid_resource, owner_required, invalid_fallback, no_rule). Unknown fields are ignored.

owner.description: The creator who owns the resource: a user SubjectRef, usr_ id, or network.

subject.description: The viewer; null or absent for a signed-out viewer (services only).

rule_id.description: The rule the product believes applies (vgr_…); a mismatch denies.

mode.description: authoritative always asks Billing; a sensitive rule always does.

fallback.description: The product's default gate: { requirement: member, binding?: "product:binding" } (or just "member"); null or false for none.
